messages:
ashley: Customer ACME Health asks for committed 500k tokens/day + ability to burst to 1.5M/day. Wants single blended per-token rate, credits up front, and clear overage logic. Need product sign-off before we send proposal. cc @jamie
jamie: thanks. can you paste their current monthly tokens + variance? do they need VPC/private deployment or is hosted ok? timeline?
ashley: currently ~12M tokens/month, ~20% 95th percentile spikes. Regulatory: PHI, so they want Private deployment. customer wants legal + pricing by EOD Fri.
sophia: support note: they've filed two incidents for latency during spikes; they prefer reserved capacity to avoid throttling. attaching incident IDs in the ticket.
mike: quick calc suggestion:
```
blended_rate = (commit_tokens * commit_price + burst_tokens * burst_price) / total_tokens
```
If we offer credits, we need to keep min margin ~30%. Also recommend a reserved cushion (10%) before overage kicks in.
jamie: product take: two viable approaches:
- Option A: Commit baseline (500k/d) @ low per-token + burst @ higher per-token (auto-fallback). predictable and safe.
- Option B: Single blended rate if commit >= 60% of expected usage and legal ok. simpler for procurement but higher risk to margin.
I lean Option A for enterprise; preserves SLOs and cost controls. Launch criteria: SLA & latency targets documented, KMS + audit logs validated, pricing calc + templated SOW, and finance sign-off.
ashley: customer strongly prefers single billable rate to simplify procurement/PO. they'll push back on two-line billing.
mike: if we consider single rate, model 6-12 month usage scenarios and include a sustained-overage repricing clause (e.g., sustained >120% for 30 days triggers repricing). also run sensitivity on month-to-month variance.
jamie: immediate ask for sales to fill intake: 1) last 6 months token histogram (by day) 2) confirm deployment mode (Hosted | Dedicated | Private) 3) acceptable margin floor (min %) 4) compliance & legal contacts 5) desired contract length. I'll create a pricing template and draft SOW skeleton.
ashley: adding those to the ticket now. marking priority P1 for enterprise sales motion. assigning to @jamie and @mike.
deploy-bot: ticket #PRICING-472 created by ashley
jamie: I'll own the proposal draft. target draft by Thu COB. if we go single blended, include a 3-month review clause and a 30-day notice for sustained spikes.
mike: will run modeling and share a sensitivity table (best/worst/median) + recommended cushion.
sophia: I'll upload incident history and flag latency SLOs for the Private deployment checklist.
ashley: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update customer once draft is ready.
